01 — About

Produc- tion AI, Engi- neered

End to end — from agent architecture to the interface people actually use.

I'm a Python / Generative AI full-stack developer with 3+ years of professional software development experience building production AI applications with Python/FastAPI, React/Next.js, Google ADK, Gemini, Dialogflow CX, and Vertex AI.

My hands-on work spans agentic AI, LLM integration, RAG, asynchronous processing, secure APIs, GCP deployment, Docker/Kubernetes, TensorFlow, and PyTorch. At Brightspeed, the conversational-AI quality platform I built generated ~$900K in annual profit impact and cut the AI regression cycle time by 80% through LLM-based semantic evaluation and asynchronous job pipelines.

I hold an M.S. in Business Analytics & Artificial Intelligence from The University of Texas at Dallas, a graduate certificate in Applied Machine Learning, and an IEEE publication (2024) on deep learning and cryptography for privacy-preserving medical image security.

What I focus on

  • Multi-agent systems with Google ADK, A2A messaging & MCP tool calling
  • LLM evaluation, regression & compliance automation for conversational AI
  • FastAPI services with async jobs, scoped JWT access & quota-aware concurrency
  • RAG pipelines with Vertex AI Search, BigQuery & GCS
  • Cloud Run deployments with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus & Grafana observability

06 — How I work

One training Run, end to end

Every production system I ship follows the same seven stages — the loop below is how the Brightspeed platform went from brief to a measured ~$900K a year.

STEP 01

Brief

Define the job the AI must do, who it serves, and the metric that proves it worked — before any model is chosen.

STEP 02

Data

Ground the system: Dialogflow CX flows, Vertex AI Search indexes, BigQuery and GCS sources, scoped access from day one.

STEP 03

Baseline

Ship the simplest working version — one agent, real prompts, real traffic shape — and measure it honestly.

STEP 04

Error analysis

Read the failures, not just the scores. Semantic evaluation with an LLM judge surfaces where answers drift, hallucinate, or break policy.

STEP 05

Iteration

Split work across specialised agents with A2A messaging and MCP tools; add failure isolation so one bad tool can't sink a run.

STEP 06

Evaluation

Automated regression, security and compliance checks on every change — the cycle that got 80% faster at Brightspeed.

STEP 07

Ship

Cloud Run deployment with quota-aware concurrency, backoff recovery, and OpenTelemetry / Prometheus / Grafana watching it live.

The interface matters as much as the model — an agent nobody can use is just a demo. That's why every stage above ends in something a person can click, read, or measure.
